title: Writing Development
goal: Develop writing from alphabet and word spelling to structured essays, summaries and professional communication, with feedback at every step.

modules.title: From Letters to Sentences
modules.description: The mechanics of writing: letter formation, word spelling, sentence writing and expansion, at A1.

lessons.title: Alphabet Writing and Word Spelling
objectives: Write all 26 letters by hand or keyboard fluently
Spell the first 60 core words correctly
lessons.assessment: Spell 18 of 20 dictated core words correctly with proper letter forms

lessons.title: Sentence Writing
objectives: Write grammatical sentences from prompts
Apply capitalisation and end punctuation consistently
lessons.assessment: Write 8 prompted sentences with 7 grammatical and correctly punctuated

lessons.title: Sentence Expansion
objectives: Expand simple sentences with adjectives, adverbs and phrases
Keep expanded sentences correct
lessons.assessment: Expand 5 sentences correctly in two stages each

checkpoint.criteria: Write correctly spelled, punctuated and expanded sentences from prompts

modules.title: Paragraphs
modules.description: Connected writing at A2: joining sentences, paragraph construction, topic sentences, supporting details and conclusions.

lessons.title: Connected Sentences
objectives: Link sentences with and, but, so, because and then
Keep pronoun reference clear across sentences
lessons.assessment: Turn 6 sentence groups into connected mini-texts with correct linkers

lessons.title: Topic Sentences
objectives: Write a clear topic sentence
Recognise and repair off-topic sentences
lessons.assessment: Write 4 topic sentences and identify 4 off-topic sentences

lessons.title: Supporting Details
objectives: Support topic sentences with 2-3 relevant details
Use examples, reasons and facts as support
lessons.assessment: Develop 3 topic sentences into full paragraphs with relevant support

lessons.title: Conclusions
objectives: End paragraphs with a closing sentence
Restate or reflect without repeating word-for-word
lessons.assessment: Complete 3 paragraphs with appropriate closing sentences

modules.title: Writing Genres
modules.description: Real writing purposes at B1: descriptive, narrative and opinion writing, plus practical texts — letters, applications, emails, notices and reports.

lessons.title: Descriptive Writing
objectives: Describe a place or person with sensory detail
Organise description spatially or by importance
lessons.assessment: Write a 120-word description with at least 5 specific details

lessons.title: Narrative Writing
objectives: Tell a story with clear sequence and one turning point
Use past tenses consistently in narration
lessons.assessment: Write a 150-word story with clear beginning, problem and resolution

lessons.title: Opinion Writing
objectives: State an opinion and support it with two reasons and an example
Use opinion language: I think, in my view
lessons.assessment: Write a structured opinion paragraph: opinion, 2 reasons, 1 example

checkpoint.criteria: Write descriptive, narrative and opinion texts of 120-150 words with structure

lessons.title: Letters
objectives: Write a personal letter with greeting, body and sign-off
Match register to recipient
lessons.assessment: Write a correct 100-word personal letter with proper format

lessons.title: Applications
objectives: Write a short, honest application (course, membership, job)
Present relevant personal information clearly
lessons.assessment: Write a 100-word application including all required elements

lessons.title: Emails and Notices
objectives: Write clear emails with subject, greeting, purpose and closing
Write short public notices with the key information first
lessons.assessment: Write one request email and one notice, both complete and clear

lessons.title: Reports
objectives: Structure a short factual report: introduction, findings, conclusion
Keep report language objective
lessons.assessment: Write a 150-word report with three labelled sections

checkpoint.criteria: Produce the five practical text types with correct formats and register

modules.title: Advanced Writing
modules.description: B2 writing: full essays, summaries and professional communication.

lessons.title: Essay Writing
objectives: Plan and write a 250-word essay: introduction, two body paragraphs, conclusion
Support arguments with linked reasons
lessons.assessment: Write a 250-word essay with clear structure and support

lessons.title: Summaries
objectives: Summarise a 350-word text in about 80 words in own words
Preserve the source meaning without copying phrases
lessons.assessment: Write an 80-word summary that preserves all key points in own words

checkpoint.criteria: Write structured essays and accurate summaries within word limits

lessons.title: Professional Emails and Messages
objectives: Write polite, clear workplace emails: request, update, follow-up
Choose appropriate tone and level of formality
lessons.assessment: Write 3 workplace emails (request, update, follow-up) with correct tone

lessons.title: Professional Reports and Documents
objectives: Write a structured professional document with headings and data references
Keep language precise and impersonal where required
lessons.assessment: Write a 200-word structured document referencing given data correctly

checkpoint.criteria: Produce professional documents with correct tone, structure and precision

exitAssessment.title: Writing Development Exit Test
exitAssessment.criteria: Mechanics and spelling accuracy; a structured 150-word narrative or opinion text; one practical text (email or letter) with correct format and register; a 250-word essay with introduction, support and conclusion; an 80-word summary preserving key points.
